parameters.name: CertIdentifier
parameters.description: The certificate ID followed by "-cn-hangzhou". For example, if the certificate ID is \`123\`, the value of CertIdentifier is \`123-cn-hangzhou\`.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The accelerated domain name for which you want to configure the SM certificate.

> The domain name must use HTTPS acceleration.

parameters.name: SSLProtocol
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the SM certificate.

- **on**: enable.
- **off**: disable.
